summary: Validated 'Mostrar/Esconder anos anteriores' toggles on /vacations page. Backend honors include_past query param on both endpoints (default=false hides past approvals; true returns full history). Frontend has two independent toggles ('toggle-past-years' for Meus Pedidos and 'toggle-past-years-admin' for admin Férias por Colaborador) — both flip text + amber styling and re-fetch correctly. 6/6 backend tests pass; UI verified end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: vacations.py:118-140 my-requests: include_past=False uses $or[status!=approved OR start_date>={year}-01-01]. String comparison on ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' is correct (lexicographic == chronological).
vacations.py:293-326 all-balances: include_past=False adds start_date>={year}-01-01 to status='approved' query. Both endpoints compute current_year per-request — correct.

Vacations.jsx:48-67 onChange handlers call fetchRequests(next)/fetchAllBalances(next) explicitly to avoid useEffect race-conditions — clean. State for the two toggles is fully separate (showPastYears vs showPastYearsAdmin).
